- **Economy & missions** — cash/health/ammo pickups scattered around, plus a repeatable **delivery mission loop** (yellow marker → timed drive to blue marker → cash reward scaled by distance).
- **Full HUD** — rotating minimap with blips, cash, ammo, stars, health bar, contextual prompts, toasts, GTA-style WASTED/BUSTED screens; synthesized sound effects (no audio files); adaptive resolution for weak machines.
